"JUMBO BUCKS" offers a top prize of $2 million and twelve prize levels in all. The prize money leans toward many smaller prizes. Games shaped like this pay out often, in small amounts. This design never changes, while every other number on this page does.

Every line of JUMBO BUCKS's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
1639.headline: How this game pays out

1640.body:
On "MEGA BUCKS", one $5 million top prize was claimed two days ago. That leaves two of the original four. The smaller prizes are still available, and this page has the full count.

The second-biggest prize left on "MEGA BUCKS" is $100,000, with six of them remaining.

If you play "MEGA BUCKS" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
1640.headline: The top prize list got shorter

1641.body:
"POWER 20X" has 841,078 prizes of $5 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $10,000 prize, with five left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

The numbers for "POWER 20X" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
1641.headline: A close look at the prizes

1642.body:
Only a small slice of the tickets for "$500,000 CASH BLITZ" have been sold. The game is early in its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

The numbers for "$500,000 CASH BLITZ" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
1642.headline: Tickets sold so far

1643.body:
"WILD 9S" is down to seventeen top prizes after a $9,000 winner was claimed earlier this week. The game started with eighteen top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

Every line of WILD 9S's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
1643.headline: Fewer $9,000 prizes left

1644.body:
"MONEY ROLL" just went on sale in Florida. The game has thirteen full prize levels with six top prizes of $50,000. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

Every line of MONEY ROLL's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
1644.headline: First day on sale

1645.body:
"BLACK PEARLS" is new from the Florida Lottery. It is a $5 game with four top prizes of $1 million. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Everything above about "BLACK PEARLS" comes from the Florida Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
1645.headline: Brand new, no claims yet

1646.body:
The key fact about "$2,000,000 SPECTACULAR" is how its fourteen prize levels are built. The prize money leans toward the smaller prizes. Games built like this pay out often, in small amounts. Prize counts change daily, but this design does not.

The odds printed on the back of "$2,000,000 SPECTACULAR" are most accurate right now, before many prizes have been claimed.

Everything here about "$2,000,000 SPECTACULAR" comes from official Florida lottery numbers, current through September 29.
1646.headline: Same price, different prizes

1647.body:
"$15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT" has joined the Florida lineup at $30 with two top prizes of $15 million. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

If "$15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.

The numbers for "FLORIDA 300X THE CASH" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.

5055.body:
"EMERALD MINE 9X" is in the last part of its run, with only a small slice of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

The numbers for "EMERALD MINE 9X" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
5055.headline: Where this game is in its run

Everything here about "JEOPARDY" comes from official Florida lottery numbers, current through September 29.
5056.headline: Early stage or late

5060.headline: No $50,000 prize is left

5063.body:
CA$H IN HAND's prizes make it a game with most of its money in small, frequent prizes. Of the prize money still unclaimed, most is in wins under $1,000. The prize counts change every day, but this design does not.

The numbers for "CA$H IN HAND" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
5063.headline: The prize mix in this game

7028.body:
Of the unclaimed prize money on "THE PERFECT GIFT", most is in wins under $5,000. The game is a game that pays many small prizes and few large ones. That is neither good nor bad, only how it was designed. Choose the kind of game that fits the win you want.

Every line of THE PERFECT GIFT's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
